required_cases.purpose: Inject at the real lazy descriptor initialization allocation; first call returns a controlled failure or safely retries without hanging.
One initializer and at least two concurrent waiters; after injected failure every caller terminates.
Inspect descriptor table, generated pool, message factory, extensions, default instances, class data and reflection state across failure.
Retry the same descriptor and compare canonical measure/encode bytes byte-for-byte with no-fault control.
Run the real precommit allocation sweep without prewarming or fault relocation; no timeout, deadlock or canonical mutation.
Document, Scene, History cursor and redo branch unchanged for rejected intent; truthful receipt.
Pinned archive extraction and patch application are deterministic and fail closed on mismatch or duplicate application.
Patch-set digest changes runtime identity and prevents reuse of unpatched cached assets.
Identical locked sources, patches and toolchain reproduce the same runtime package identity/bytes under current contract.
Relevant upstream tests, SDK smoke/consumer tests and supported producer CI cells pass.
Real D07 coordinator/Scene/Intent suite passes, including grouped Undo and OOM tests.
All 160 frozen Selection IDs pass at resulting Axiom revision; historical passes are not substituted.

required_profiles.semantic_sdk_producer_ci: all selected host/runtime cells required by existing release contract
required_profiles.chrome_wasm: required after patched SDK consumer is available and locked toolchain supports it
required_profiles.physical_touch: not required for SDK exception-safety task
